name: Sakurano Machiko
source:
One of the thieving foxgirls. Seemingly mysterious, but in truth she is quite the lazy foxgirl who dislikes to do work and would love nothing more than to just lie down and relax or sleep. However, she cares a lot about her younger sister and seems to know more than she lets on. The one that flirts with the MC the most.
